plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its applications across various domains.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its applications across various domains.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Machine learning relies on mathematical concepts such as probability theory, linear algebra, and calculus to model and analyze data.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the definition and scope of machine learning is essential to grasp its role in modern computing.
examples: Definition of machine learning as a field
Distinction between supervised and unsupervised learning

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Seeing how machine learning is applied in real life helps students appreciate its practical significance.

blocks.title: Why Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the motivations behind the development of machine learning helps students grasp its importance in solving complex problems.

blocks.title: Big Picture of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: The big picture of machine learning provides a conceptual framework for understanding its different types and applications.
examples: Taking picking fruits as an example to illustrate learning processes

blocks.title: Examples of Machine Learning Tasks
blocks.teachingObjective: Concrete examples of regression, classification, and clustering help students understand the practical implementation of machine learning.
